title: A library considers a quieter hour
aim: Make the library easier to use without excluding people who need its existing services.
proposition: Try a quiet hour on Tuesday afternoons.

evidence.text: Staff noted 12 requests for quieter study space over four Tuesday afternoons.

evidence.source: Fictional service desk notes, same four Tuesdays
evidence.text: The service desk helped 20 people with printing or computer questions during those hours.
A small meeting room is free for three of the next four Tuesday afternoons; its capacity is eight.

unknowns: How many people would use a quiet hour?
Would a quiet hour make it harder to get help at the service desk?
Would the smaller room meet access needs?
